observed_failure.message: perf acknowledgement protocol failed: unexpected queued acknowledgement bytes

independent_scope_defect.correction: Use default workload mode with inherited events, retain existing enforced cgroup CPU quota and affinity, and admit every sample against the CLI's actual process_id.
